PerkDescription.zh: 开局拥有元气少女同伴。她勇敢且活力满满，总是带着笑容和好奇心迎接每一个挑战，并用无拘无束的永恒热情感染人们去拥抱整个世界。
PerkDescription.en:
Makes you start with the Spirited partner. 
Bold and full of life, she meets every challenge with laughter and curiosity, encouraging others to embrace the world with the same boundless enthusiasm.
